context_markdown:
This register records **31 known, intentional differences** between the supplied printed source and the current working edition. These choices are adopted for this edition; they do not reconstruct the original transcriber’s intentions.

All three movements and all 49 supplied source pages were visually compared, with enlarged checks of identified passages. This is a working edition, not a new critical edition or an exhaustive guarantee of every small mark. The source is the Universal Edition first edition as reprinted by Boosey & Hawkes.

Bar numbers restart with each movement. The report follows the native transcription: I.1–179, II.1–577 and III.1–141. Captions identify the target location; images include surrounding context. Some long passages have an additional image below the principal comparison.

records.summary: The continuing crescendo uses dashed lines and parenthesized (cresc.) reminders at native system breaks.
records.title: ED-001 — Crescendo continuation wording
records.body_markdown:
**Source:** The continuing crescendo is qualified by sempre and carried with continuation dashes.

**Edition:** The continuing crescendo uses dashed lines and parenthesized (cresc.) reminders at native system breaks.

**Editorial reason:** Retained as an explicit engraving choice for this edition; the underlying musical instruction is preserved.
